title: Forge Permission
description: Access-control entry over the filesystem for a given actor role. Distinct from Rule: Permission answers 'is this action allowed at all' (evaluated deterministically by Node before an action runs); Rule answers 'is this change good/compliant' (evaluated by Node or a Reviewer, often needs judgement). Node evaluates permissions in `priority` order (higher first); the first matching entry wins; if nothing matches, default is deny.

project_id.description: Omit for a global permission that applies across all projects.

path.description: Glob pattern relative to project root, e.g. 'src/**', '.forge/**', '.env'.
